rules: **Respect every shadow.** No harassment, hate speech, discrimination, threats or personal attacks.
**Keep it safe for work.** No NSFW, gore or shock content, including in names, avatars and bios.
**No spam.** No message flooding, mass pings, caps-lock or emoji walls.
**No advertising.** No self-promo, server invites or DM ads unless a moderator approves it.
**Use the right channel.** Read each channel's topic. Off-topic talk goes in #chat-room.
**No piracy or malware.** No cracked software, pirated assets, leaks or malicious files and links.
**Ethical security only.** Cybersecurity talk is for learning and defence. No hacking real targets, doxxing or sharing tools to harm others.
**Give credit.** Don't pass off someone else's edits, art or code as your own.
**Protect privacy.** Never share anyone's personal info, and be careful with your own.
**Follow Discord's rules.** Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines apply here, and you must be 13 or older.
**Moderators have the final say.** Disagree with a decision? DM a moderator, don't argue in public.
guidance: Stuck or new? Start in {guides} and ask questions in {chat}.
See something wrong? Report the message or ping a moderator.
Breaking the rules leads to: warning → mute → kick → ban, depending on how serious it is.

text.joinLine: {user} has stepped out of the light.
text.title: A new shadow has awakened
text.lore: We work from the shadows. Learn our ways, pick your path, then go make some noise.
text.footer: Hide in the shadows, rise in the garden
text.goodbyeLine: Their shadow fades, but the garden remembers.
